description: This file contains utility functions for loading configuration files from S3 and GCS, as well as downloading Python files from these storage services. It handles AWS credentials, YAML parsing, and logging related to file retrieval.

methods.name: get_file_contents_from_s3(bucket_name, object_key)
methods.description: Retrieves and parses a YAML configuration file from an S3 bucket using boto3 and IAM credentials.

methods.name: get_config_file_contents_from_gcs(bucket_name, object_key)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and parses a YAML configuration file from a GCS bucket.

methods.name: bool download_python_file_from_s3( bucket_name: str, object_key: str, local_file_path: str, )
methods.description: Downloads a Python script from an S3 bucket and saves it to a local path.

methods.name: bool download_python_file_from_gcs( bucket_name: str, object_key: str, local_file_path: str, )
methods.description: Asynchronously downloads a Python script from GCS and saves it locally.

ctags.name: download_python_file_from_gcs
ctags.signature: ( bucket_name: str, object_key: str, local_file_path: str, )

ctags.name: download_python_file_from_s3
ctags.signature: ( bucket_name: str, object_key: str, local_file_path: str, )
